title: Heat decomposition / heat curves
notes: Heat decomposition on full features_v2_wx. C3 cool/mild/warm/hot from wx_temp_c_05→wx_mean_temp_c. Null weather never invented as zero. api vs local_fallback reported in coverage. Melbourne elev N/A irrelevant.
method: Streaming aggregates from features_v2_wx; valid_splits + resolvable weather; C3 WEATHER_BANDS; Smyth HTW + severity + splits + finish quantiles; no race_records writes
answer_prose: Among 2,315,085 valid-split finishers with resolvable race weather (wx_temp_c_05→wx_mean_temp_c; C3 bands cool<10 / mild[10,15) / warm[15,21) / hot≥21 °C), HTW by band: cool 26.3% (n=881,673), mild 31.6% (n=1,117,386), warm 34.6% (n=228,884), hot 31.1% (n=87,142) — peak in warm, with hot smaller-n and mixed city mix. Mean severity still climbs with heat (0.108 → 0.121 → 0.130 → 0.132). Positive-split rate: cool 87.8%, hot 93.4%; mean split_ratio cool 1.1039 vs hot 1.1413. Finish median (p50 min): cool 241.0, mild 250.3, warm 255.1, hot 282.0. Men’s hot HTW 37.7% vs women’s 20.5%. Weather coverage on full corpus: wx_mean_temp_c nonnull 88.2%, wx_source=api 89.9%, local_fallback 10.1% (nulls never treated as zero).
methodology_prose: Source: features_v2_wx.parquet (n_features=3,167,990). Analysis rows: valid_splits==True and resolvable weather temp (priority wx_temp_c_05 then wx_mean_temp_c; race_morning_temp_c/temp_c absent on this file). C3 weather bands (°C): cool <10; mild [10,15); warm [15,21); hot ≥21; null if missing — never invented. n_rows_used=2,315,085; of those, valid+hourly+temp=2,315,085. HTW = Smyth binary flag (unchanged). Severity = features_v2 continuous wall severity. positive_split is the signed float on the dump (rate = share >0); split_ratio = second/first half pace. Finish quantiles in minutes. Late-race table bands mean of wx_temp_c_35/40/42 vs gap_dos_*/severity. City table keeps cities with ≥5,000 banded rows. wx_source distinguished api vs local_fallback in coverage. Maps to S9/R15. No race_records writes.

ux.note: Sight must not invent copy; numbers from Analyst dumps only.
